entry_gate: primary coloc-SuSiE signal pair that satisfies the locked shared-signal rule at p12=1e-5 and remains prior-robust across the full p12 grid
selection_timing: after fine-mapping/colocalization but before mechanistic source searches
supported_evidence_requirements: stable variant/regulatory-element/gene/cell/pathway or perturbation identifier as applicable
exact source dataset or accession and release
direction and quantitative metric when the source reports them
chain_policy: Every edge must cite one or more validated mechanistic evidence IDs or an explicit upstream fine-mapping/colocalization lock identifier; missing edges remain explicit and chains may not skip unsupported biological steps.

confidence_classes.MULTI_LAYER_HUMAN_GENETIC_SUPPORT: replicated pair plus prior-robust molecular-QTL colocalization, fine-mapped regulatory evidence, and context-matched tissue/cell evidence for the same gene with no unresolved contradiction
confidence_classes.COLOCALIZED_MOLECULAR_SUPPORT: prior-robust molecular-QTL colocalization for the gene but an incomplete regulatory or cellular chain
confidence_classes.ANNOTATION_ONLY_SUPPORT: gene is supported only by mapping, expression, regulatory overlap, pathway, or model-system annotation without molecular-QTL colocalization
confidence_classes.INSUFFICIENT_OR_CONFLICTING: no supported gene-level chain or a material direction/context/source contradiction remains

claim_limit: Mechanistic synthesis ranks evidence under explicit provenance. It does not prove that a variant, regulatory element, gene, cell state, pathway, or perturbation causally mediates either phenotype.
